Details: CoupledExpression[data] is an immutable coupled term: its expressions with source channels, one coefficient each, their sum (Value), parameter records, a fresh TermID and the field, target and context identities when known.
A copy keeps its TermID, so adding it to a model twice fails; a separately constructed equal term gets a new ID.
CoupledExpression.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; Head[t]]

Details: Coupling[id] is an inert model parameter: an independent complex scalar constant under the finite group.

Each generated coupling has a fresh ID and a display label; using the same Coupling atom in several terms shares that parameter explicitly. Parameter records supply substitution keys for numerical values.
Coupling.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; Head[First[CouplingParameters[t]]["Atom"]]]

Details: CoupleContractions[set] attaches one fresh Coupling to each independent channel of the ContractionSet set (computing IndependentContractions when needed) and returns a CoupledExpression that is covariant by construction.

Options: ChannelPolicy, Couplings, CouplingPrefix and ParameterSymbols. The set itself is not changed. Approximate explicit couplings (real or complex) need a numerical set (NumericalInput otherwise) and bound the term's precision: a machine-precision coupling gives a MachinePrecision term.
CoupleContractions.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; Length[CouplingParameters[t]]]

Details: CoupleExpressions[{e1, e2, ...}] attaches one coefficient to each scalar expression that is not proved zero and returns a CoupledExpression whose symmetry is Unverified.

It makes no independence or covariance claim; AddModelTerm checks covariance when the term joins a model. Options: Couplings, ParameterSymbols, CouplingPrefix, Arithmetic, WorkingPrecision and Tolerance; approximate numbers need Arithmetic -> "Numerical". A numerical Tolerance below 10^-digits of the data's precision fails with InvalidOption.
CoupleExpressions.Example: Module[{x, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; x = FieldComponents[l]; Lookup[CouplingParameters[CoupleExpressions[{x[[1]]^2, 0, x[[2]]^2}, Couplings -> {alpha, beta}, ParameterSymbols -> {alpha, beta}]], "Label"]]

Details: CouplingParameters[e] lists the parameter records of the CoupledExpression e, each <|"Atom" -> Coupling[ID], "ID", "Label", "Domain" -> "Complex", "SourceAtom"|>, in first-appearance order.
SourceAtom holds a declared user symbol (HoldForm) as metadata; later definitions of that symbol do not change the term.
CouplingParameters.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; First[CouplingParameters[t]]["Domain"]]

Details: CoupledExpressionValue[e] is the scalar value of the CoupledExpression e: the sum of coefficient times expression, in inert field components and Coupling atoms.
CoupledExpressionValue.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; Sort[DeleteDuplicates[Cases[CoupledExpressionValue[t], _FieldComponent, Infinity]]] === Sort[Join[FieldComponents[l], FieldComponents[r]]]]

Details: AddModelTerm[m, e] returns a new model containing the CoupledExpression e after checking that it uses only the model's fields and declared parameters, matches its context and target, and transforms with the target character on every generator (simultaneous substitution, exact coefficients).
The term ID must be new to the model; shared parameters must have consistent records. Numerical terms give a numerical status, never an exact certificate. The input model is unchanged.
AddModelTerm.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; {ModelExpression[m], Length[ModelParameters[m2]]}]
AddModelTerm.ErrorExample: Module[{x, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; x = FieldComponents[l]; FailureQ[AddModelTerm[m, CoupleExpressions[{x[[1]] FieldComponents[r][[1]]}]]]]

Details: ModelExpression[m] is the exact sum of the values of the model's terms (0 for no terms); no overall scale is removed.
ModelExpression.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; Expand[ModelExpression[m2] - CoupledExpressionValue[t]]]

Details: ModelParameters[m] lists the parameter records of the model in first-appearance order, independent of how the expression sorts.
ModelParameters.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; Length[ModelParameters[m2]]]

Details: ValidateModel[m] recomputes the covariance of the model and of each term on every recorded generator and returns <|"ModelID", "Covariant", "Status", "Terms", "Generators", "Precision", "Tolerance"|>.

Status is "Covariant", "Covariant (numerical)" or "NotCovariant"; nothing stored in the model is trusted. A coefficient equality that cannot be decided gives an UndecidableCovariance Failure. In numerical arithmetic a coefficient is zero only when every sampled value is within tolerance; a symbolic coefficient whose values are small but not provably zero is undecidable rather than accepted.

The report's "VerificationStatus" is the weakest of the model's inputs (group, field and target variants), its terms' sources and the level of the covariance checks; a modular model whose terms use a space supplied with SupplyModularFormSpace is "Unverified" (the space's completeness is the user's assertion).
ValidateModel.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; ValidateModel[m2]["Status"]]

Details: MassMatrix[data] holds a bilinear or quadratic coefficient matrix: input and selected expressions, remainder, matrix and dimensions, row and column variables, convention, arithmetic, precision and tolerance, parameter records, and the field identities, names and frozen context when extracted from Fields.
Read the matrix with MatrixValues; ValidateMassMatrix certifies it against a model.
MassMatrix.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; Head[ExtractBilinearMatrix[ModelExpression[m2], l, r]]]

Details: ExtractBilinearMatrix[expr, rows, cols] gives a MassMatrix with selected == rows . M . cols, where selected is the part of expr of degree one in rows and one in cols; other terms remain in Remainder.

rows and cols are nonempty, duplicate-free, disjoint lists of variables (for example joined FieldComponents); ExtractBilinearMatrix[expr, f1, f2] uses the components of Fields. No complex conjugation is applied.

Options: RequirePure (default False), Arithmetic ("Exact" by default, or "Numerical" with WorkingPrecision and Tolerance). The extraction takes an expression, not a model, so a numerical model's matrix needs Arithmetic -> "Numerical"; approximate input with exact arithmetic fails with NumericalInput, and reconstruction is then judged within the declared tolerance.

ExtractQuadraticMatrix[expr, x] gives the symmetric M with selected == x . M . x, where selected is the part of expr of degree two in the variables x: diagonal entries are the x_i^2 coefficients and off-diagonal entries half the x_i x_j coefficients.
QuadraticConvention -> "Half" gives selected == (x . M . x)/2 instead. ExtractQuadraticMatrix[expr, f] uses the components of a Field.
Options: QuadraticConvention, RequirePure, Arithmetic ("Exact" by default, or "Numerical" with WorkingPrecision and Tolerance; approximate input needs "Numerical").
ExtractQuadraticMatrix.Example: MatrixValues[ExtractQuadraticMatrix[a p^2 + b p q + c q^2, {p, q}]]

Details: MatrixValues[mass] is the coefficient matrix of the MassMatrix mass; its entries are free of the row and column variables.
MatrixValues.Example: MatrixValues[ExtractBilinearMatrix[p1 q2 + 5 p2 q1, {p1, p2}, {q1, q2}]]

Details: ValidateMassMatrix[m, mass] certifies that mass was extracted from ModelExpression[m], that its rows, columns or quadratic variables consist of whole field multiplets of m, that the selected sector and remainder reconstruct the input, and that P_i^T . M . Q_i == chi_target(g_i) M on every generator (spectator fields in M transformed too).
A matrix extracted from another expression fails with SourceModelMismatch; partial multiplets fail with NonClosedFieldSelection.

The source and covariance checks use the model's own arithmetic settings, never the matrix's: an exact model judges exactly, and a numerical model (or one with a numerical term) judges residuals with the model's WorkingPrecision and Tolerance, giving Status "Covariant (numerical)", never an exact certificate. The matrix, selected sector and remainder are re-derived from the input expression with those settings and must agree with the record; a record's own tolerance never certifies it (InvalidMassMatrix otherwise). The result reports the "Precision" and "Tolerance" used (Infinity and Missing["Exact"] for exact arithmetic). Recorded row and column fields must be the fields of the matrix variables.
The report's "VerificationStatus" is the weakest of the model's status, the matrix's (its fields' variants) and the level of the check.
ValidateMassMatrix.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; mass = ExtractBilinearMatrix[ModelExpression[m2], l, r]; ValidateMassMatrix[m2, mass]["Covariant"]]
ValidateMassMatrix.ErrorExample: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]; m2 = AddModelTerm[m, t]; FailureQ[ValidateMassMatrix[m2, ExtractBilinearMatrix[0, l, r]]]]

Details: Option for CreateModel: the irrep with whose character the model's scalar terms transform; the model then describes scalars transforming with that character.
Automatic (default, the recorded trivial irrep) or the ID of an irrep of degree one with accepted matrices.
Higher-dimensional or unknown targets fail with InvalidTarget; a target without accepted matrices fails with MissingRepresentations.
TargetIrrep.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Length[Contractions[CreateModel[g, {l, r}, TargetIrrep -> sign], {l, r}]["Channels"]]]
TargetIrrep.ErrorExample: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; FailureQ[CreateModel[g, {l}, TargetIrrep -> d]]]

Details: Option for CoupleContractions: which channels receive couplings. "Independent" couples one basis polynomial per independent channel; "AllChannels" couples every provably nonzero channel and reports the linear dependencies in the term's Relations.
"Independent" (default) or "AllChannels".
Other values fail with InvalidOption before any computation.
ChannelPolicy.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; q = CreateModel[g, {l}]; raw = Contractions[q, {l, l, l, l}]; {Length[CouplingParameters[CoupleContractions[raw]]], Length[CouplingParameters[CoupleContractions[raw, ChannelPolicy -> "AllChannels"]]]}]
ChannelPolicy.ErrorExample: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; q = CreateModel[g, {l}]; raw = Contractions[q, {l, l, l, l}]; FailureQ[CoupleContractions[raw, ChannelPolicy -> "Some"]]]

Details: Option for CoupleContractions and CoupleExpressions: the coefficients attached to the retained terms. Explicit coefficients must be free of field components; their symbols must be declared with ParameterSymbols, and existing Coupling atoms are shared.
Automatic (default, one fresh Coupling per retained term) or a list of coefficient expressions, one per retained term.
A list of the wrong length fails with InvalidOption; field components give FieldDependentCoupling and undeclared symbols UndeclaredSymbol.
Couplings.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}], Couplings -> {1}]; FreeQ[CoupledExpressionValue[t], _Coupling]]
Couplings.ErrorExample: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; FailureQ[CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}], Couplings -> {1, 2}]]]

Details: Option for CoupleContractions and CoupleExpressions: the label prefix of generated couplings; it affects display labels only, never parameter identity.
A string (default "c").
Other values fail with InvalidOption.
CouplingPrefix.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; t = CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}], CouplingPrefix -> "y"]; StringStartsQ[First[CouplingParameters[t]]["Label"], "y"]]
CouplingPrefix.ErrorExample: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; FailureQ[CoupleContractions[Contractions[m, {l, r}], CouplingPrefix -> 1]]]

Details: Option for CoupleContractions and CoupleExpressions: user symbols or indexed atoms that are parameters, in the Couplings and in the supplied expressions. Each declaration that occurs becomes a new Coupling with the symbol's spelling as label and HoldForm[symbol] as SourceAtom; later definitions of the symbol do not change the term.

{} (default) or a duplicate-free list of symbols or indexed atoms; known constants such as Pi need no declaration. A spelling that already labels a parameter in this session gets a suffixed label (lambda_2): to share one parameter between terms, use its Coupling atom from CouplingParameters.

Duplicates, non-symbols, patterns and package atoms (Coupling, FieldComponent, VectorComponent) fail with InvalidOption; undeclared symbols, indexed atoms (including kk[2] when only kk is declared), strings or foreign atoms in coefficients fail with UndeclaredSymbol. Declaring both kk and kk[1] makes them two parameters; kk counts as used only where it occurs outside kk[1].
ParameterSymbols.Example: Module[{x, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; x = FieldComponents[l]; First[CouplingParameters[CoupleExpressions[{x . x}, Couplings -> {kappa}, ParameterSymbols -> {kappa}]]]["SourceAtom"]]
ParameterSymbols.ErrorExample: Module[{x, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; x = FieldComponents[l]; FailureQ[CoupleExpressions[{x . x}, Couplings -> {kappa}]]]

Details: Option for ExtractQuadraticMatrix: the normalization of the symmetric quadratic matrix.
"Polynomial" (default, selected == x . M . x) or "Half" (selected == (x . M . x)/2, the Hessian matrix).
Other values fail with InvalidOption.
QuadraticConvention.Example: MatrixValues[ExtractQuadraticMatrix[a p^2 + b p q + c q^2, {p, q}, QuadraticConvention -> "Half"]]

Details: Option for ExtractBilinearMatrix and ExtractQuadraticMatrix: whether terms outside the selected sector are allowed; with False they are kept in Remainder.
False (default) or True (fail with ImpureSector unless the remainder is zero).
Other values fail with InvalidOption.
